title: Controlling of the F Region Plasma Structures by the E Region Conductance in the Auroral Ionosphere
summary:
Abstract 
                   At high latitudes, the E and F regions of the ionosphere are strongly coupled through nearly vertical magnetic field lines. To simultaneously and directly relate the E and F regions' plasma structures, we ran a coordinated conjunction campaign between Swarm satellites and Incoherent Scatter Radar in Tromsø, Norway, during a moderate geomagnetic storm in late March 2025.
